notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Pirate Ship deathtouch.
Thornbite Staff attached to Pirate Ship.
Pirate Ship does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Give Pirate Ship deathtouch, if needed.
Activate Pirate Ship by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any creature an opponent controls, and destroying it due to Pirate Ship's deathtouch.
When the creature dies, Pirate Ship triggers, untapping Pirate Ship.
Repeat from step 2.
If the effect giving Pirate Ship deathtouch is a static effect, you may repeat this whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.
